title: Assembly window donor search
description: Find matched donor functions containing a construct similar to any normalized instruction window in the query function.
status_message: Construct-level search reads a host-built sparse hashed index of dtk target-object instruction windows.
limitations: The operator must rebuild the host index after target objects or match-report data change.
Hashed normalized 1-, 2-, and 3-gram cosine similarity is retrieval evidence, not proof that two constructs compile identically.

usage.agent_guidance: Use when whole-function similarity misses a loop or idiom inside a larger function. Treat a high score as a donor lead and inspect the reported window offsets.
